issues.title: Headrest cover height now right, but still ~1.17x too wide head-on and a little light
issues.evidence: q15 profiles: cover 80 / 84 px wide (x344-424, x504-588) vs 68-72 px in y_47300 (x356-424, x504-572). Height 48-50 vs ~48 px. Cover L53 vs 37-45 (part of that is the seat-level lift). h/w 0.60 vs 0.70.
issues.fix: In econSeat, narrow the cover plate lofts (both the SEC(0.625..0.791, 0.245..0.248, ...) and the roll-over SEC(0.789..0.81, 0.245, ...)) from 0.245-0.248 to ~0.21. Scale the hem / stitch widths (0.243/0.244 -> 0.208, 0.23 -> 0.196), the rolled-foot tube ends (+-0.117 -> +-0.10) and the ANA mark offset (-0.1 -> -0.085) to match. In econUnitFar, gBox(0.245, 0.185, 0.01) -> gBox(0.21, ...). Optionally darken SEATMAT.yCover by ~10 % (shared SEATMAT, one line).

issues.title: Tick pans still flat (p90/p10 ~3.1-3.4 vs 4.8-5.1)
issues.evidence: q15 seat 1 pan p90/p10 3.39 vs 5.13; seat 2 3.07 vs 4.81. The diamond and dash pans are within 15 %.
issues.fix: Give ECON_PAN its own tick tile contrast, or a darker base with LAYER_PARAMS gain on the y_tick swatch (e.g. ECON_PAN c photoBase darker by ~8 % with a higher tile gain), so the light ticks stay and the ground drops. Re-measure the x330-450 / y540-572 box.

issues.title: Far rows: snowy stripes, no pad ears (carried)
issues.evidence: Far centre L131 B/R 1.32 vs 115 / 1.48; far left p90/p10 3.62 vs 5.88, unchanged since w33.
issues.fix: In econUnitFar, use a flat, bluer far material for the backs (no tick tile, or a low-gain tile; mean ~#66739a) and give the headrest box ECON_HEAD_L-coloured ear blocks 0.07 wide at +-0.16, proud of the cover, so the ears read beside the dark cover.

issues.title: Pillows are plain plaques; fleck specks read as holes (carried)
issues.evidence: z_low: straight-edged rounded rectangles vs y_47300's puffed bow-tie with pointed corners and a centre dent. e11: ~15 dark haloed specks per fleck pan.
issues.fix: Pillow: loft its outline with corner points pulled out ~1.5 cm and the edge midpoints pinched in ~1 cm, and add a 5 mm centre dent (2-3 sections with reduced thickness at the middle). Fleck: clamp the dark end of the y_fleck swatch in make_swatches (or raise its floor in LAYER_PARAMS) so the specks lose their halos.

issues.title: Hard black tray edge under the pan front; pouch a flat uniform disc; belt V (open question)
issues.evidence: e7 / e11: the 0.41-deep tray (#2c2f35) shows as a crisp black line under every pan front; y_47302 shows a soft dark cavity. The pouch has no vest form inside. Belts and buckles still form a V on every q15 pan.
issues.fix: Tray: gRBox(0.40, 0.02, 0.41) -> depth 0.39, centred at -0.25 (2 cm further back of the face), and r 0.6 -> 0.8 so it does not catch a rim light. Pouch: add an off-centre 0.045 m #6b5a48 / #55595f lump inside the rim. Belts: pending the user's answer on tucked vs laid.
